name: shellcheck (release asset, checksum-pinned)
description: Installs shellcheck from its GitHub release asset (a plain download, never the GitHub API, so the runner's shared rate limit cannot fail it) and verifies the archive against a SHA-256 pinned in install.sh for each architecture. Only versions with a pinned checksum install; add one to install.sh to bump. Used by this repository's devcontainer and CI config, not published.

version.description: The shellcheck version; it must have a checksum pinned in install.sh.
